scripts.dist: bun run build:electron && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.format: prettier --write app bridge packages tests electron .github README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.tests.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc .lintstagedrc
scripts.format:check: prettier --check app bridge packages tests electron .github README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.tests.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc .lintstagedrc
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/wire typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/gdtf-ts typecheck && bun run --cwd bridge typecheck && bun run --cwd app typecheck && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run build:electron
